translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Ikenkithatakotaitziro 10 mainawo
“Jiroka ikanta ipinkathariwentantai Inkitesatzi, roshiyatyaawo 10 mainawo jatatsiri tsireniriki itonkyotyaari aawakaachane. Aayetanake ootapiintaiyarini.
Eenitatsi okaatzi 5 mainawo kyoshiretatsiri, eenitatsi eejatzi okaatzi 5 mainawo kaari kyoshiretatsiri.
Jirokapaini 5 mainawo kaari kyoshiretatsiri aawetanakari ootapiintari, iro kantacha eepichoki aanake iyaa.
Irooma otsipa kyoshiretaintsiri, aayetanake iroori ootapiintari, aanake eejatzi osheki iyaa.
Te ripokita aawakaachane, ayimatapaakero owochokine, magaiyanakeni.
Okanta niyankiite tsireniri, okematzi ikaimaitzi, ikantaitzi: ‘¡Kaakitake aawakaachane, pitonkyotawakyaari!’
Kakitaiyanakeni mainawo, iyeekiyetanairi iyaa ootapiintari.
Mainawopaini kaari kyoshiretatsiri, okantawetanakawo kyoshiretaintsiri: ‘Pimpena iyaa pootapiintari, irootaintsi ritsiwake nashi naaka.’
Ari okantanake: ‘Te ikimaatzi nashi naaka, piyaate pamanantapainte eeroka.’
Iyaaminthaitapaintzi amanantzi, areetapaaka aawakaachane. Jirokapaini okaatzi aamaawentainchari, itonkyotawakari, raanakero tsika roimoshirenkaiteri. Rashitaitanakero otantotsi.
Okanta ipiyawetapaaka jatatsiri amanantzi, okaimakaimawetapaaka, okantapaake: ‘¡Pashitareenawo naaka!’
Okematzi rakaitanakero, ikantaitziro: ‘Te niyotzimi. Imaperotatya.’
Ontzimatye paamaawentayetaiya eeroka. Tema te piyotzi tsikapaite ripiyai Itomi Atziri.”
Ikenkithatakotaitziri koriki
“Jiroka ikanta ipinkathariwentantai Inkitesatzi, roshiyakotatyaari apaani atziri kowatsiri riyaate intaina, ipiyotakeri rimperatanewo, ipanakeri inkempoyeeniri okaatzi rashitari.

Ipanakeri apawopaini rimperatanewo iyorikite. Jirika kenkithashiretachari kameetha, impanakeri ikaatzi 5 koriki, itsipa yoneentatsiri impanakeri ikaatzi apite, iriima itsipa weyaantapaakawori impanakeri apaani. Jatake intaina.
Ikanta jirika ipaitakeri 5 koriki, rantawaitakaakeri, roshekyaakeri ragai ikaatzi 5.
Ari ikantakari ipaitakeri apite, roshekyaakeri irirori, ragai ikaatzi apite.
Iriima itsipa ipaitakeri apaani, raanakeri iyorikite, ikitatakeri kipatsiki.
Okanta osamanitake piyaawo ashitariri koriki, ikaimakaantapairi rimperatanewo riyote oita rantantakari iyorikite.
Ari ripokapaake ipaitakeri 5 koriki, roñaagapairi itsipa 5 koriki roshekyaakeri, ikantapaakeri: ‘Pinkatharí, 5 koriki pipakena pairani, jirika itsipa 5 noshekyagairi.’
Ikantzi Pinkathari: ‘Ariwé nimperatanewo, kameethashireri pini. Eepichokiini koriki pikempoyaakena, ari pinkempoyagai itsipa osheki. Pipoke, pintsipataina pinintagaiya.’
Areetapaaka ipaitakeri apite koriki, ikantapaakeri: ‘Pinkatharí, apite koriki pipakena, jirika itsipa apite noshekyagairi.’
Ikantzi pinkathari: ‘Ariwé nimperatanewo, kameethashireri pini. Eepichokiini koriki pikempoyaakena, ari pinkempoyagai osheki itsipa. Pipoke, pintsipatena pinintagaiya.’
Areetapaaka ipaitakeri apaani koriki, ikantapaakeri: ‘Pinkatharí, niyotzi naaka mashireyantzi pini, pashi powiro pantawaitakaantziri piyorikite, piñaantyaawori poshekyeeri.
Iroowa nothaawantakari, naakeri piyorikite, nokitatakeri kipatsiki. Jirika iroñaaka namaimiri.’
Rakanakeri ikantziri: ‘Kaariperoshireri pini, perantzi pini. Piyowetaka ari nonkisakemi eerorika poshekyaanari noorikite,
piñaawetaka eero pimatziro eeroka, pamineme iita antawaitakaimirine, ari ishenitaime iroñaaka, iri pimpawainarime nipiyaawowa.’
Ikantanakeri ikaatzi saikaintsiri: ‘Paapithateri koriki, pimpairi itsipa oshekyaakeriri 10 koriki.’
Ikaatzi otzimimotziri, ari ontzimimotairi osheki. Iriima kaari otzimimotzi, eekero riyaatatye iñagairo eero otzimimotairi.
Paanakeri jirika kaariperoshireri, pookeri otsirenikitzira. Ari riraawaityaari, ratsikaikiwaitya inkemaatsiwaitaiya.”
Ikenkithatakotaitziro yakowentaantsi
“Arika ripiyai Itomi Atziri pinkatha rowaitairi. Intsipataiyaari maninkariite, roshiyakotaiyaari ikanta pinkathari risaikantawo owaneenkatachari risaikamento.
Impiyotairi maawoini atziri tsikarika risaikai irirori. Rinashiyetaiyaari roisaikayetairi. Roshiyakotaiyaari atziri yoshiitziriri ipira te ikowakayiri intentaiya.
Roisaikairi ikowaperotziri rakoperoki, iriima imanintayetziri rampateki roisaikairi.

Kenkithawaitake Pinkathari, riñaanateri rinashitakari rakoperoki, inkanteri: ‘Pipoke maawoini, osheki inkimoshiretakagaimi Ashitanari, pinampitaiyaawo tsika ipinkathariwentantzi irirori, arira riwetsikaantakemi pairani owakera riwetsikantakawori kipatsi.
Tema piñaana pairani aawetana nitashe, iro kantacha pipakena nowanawo. Piñaana ayimatana nomere, pipakena nirakeri. Piñaakena nareeta pinampiki, pineshironkatakena pipankoki.
Piñaana nisagaakowaitzi, pipakena nokithaatari. Piñaana nomantsiyatake, pamitakotakena netsiyatakotantaari. Romonkyaakaantaitakena, pipokashitakena piñaana.’
Ikantaiyini kameethashireri: ‘Pinkatharí. ¿Tsikapaite noñiimika pitasheneentzi, nopantzimiri powanawo? ¿Tsika noñiimika pimereneentzi, nopantzimiri pimere?
¿Tsikapaite noñiimika, naakameethatantzimiri nopankoki? ¿Tsikapaite noñiimika pisagaakowaitzi, nopantzimiri piithaare?
¿Tsikapaite noñiimika pimantsiyatzi, romonkyagaitzimi, niyaatashitantzimiri noñiimi.’
Ari rakanake Pinkathari, ikantzi: ‘Tema pineshironkatakeri ikaatzi awentaayetanari noshiyakagairi iyeki, naakatajaantake pineshironkatake. Imaperotatya.’

Ripithokashitanakari saikaintsiri rampateki, ikantziri: ‘Kaariperorí, piyaate eeroka pinkemaatsiwaitaiya paampariki kaari tsiwakanetatsine, ikashaakaitakeriri Kamaari intsipataiyaari maawoini imaninkarite irirori.
Piñaawetakana nitasheneentzi, te pipana nowanawo. Owamaimatakena nomere, te pipana nire.
Piñaawetana nareeta pinampiki, te pineshironkatena pipankoki. Piñaawetana nisagaakowaitzi, te pipana nonkithaatyaari. Piñaawetana nomantsiyatzi, romonkyaakaantaitana, te pareetana.’

Rakanake kaariperoshireri, ikantzi: ‘Nowinkatharite, ¿tsikapaiteka noñaawetzimi pitasheneentzi, pimereneentzi, pareetanta, pisagaakowaitzi, pimantsiyatzi, romonkyagaitzimi, temaita noneshironkayetzimi.’
Ikantanake Pinkathari: ‘Te pineshironkayetantai, inkantawetakya iryaani rine, naakatake pantzimotake. Imaperotatya.’
Iroowa ratsipetantaityaawori kantaitaachane ashironkagaantsi. Iriima inkaate kameethashiretaintsiri, inkantaitaatyeero rañaayetai.”

footnotes.text: Iri ikantakoitzi jaka oweja, iri piratsi ikowaperoitakeri roisaikaiteri akoperotsiki. Iriima cabra, iri piratsi imanintaitakeri roisaikaitakeri ampatentsiki.
